import json, torch
from scripts.select_readout import select_readout
from sparsa.cli import load_model
from sparsa.data import benchmark
from sparsa.evaluate import evaluate
from sparsa.train import write_json
torch.set_num_threads(4)
device = torch.device("cuda")
run = "s3://marin-us-east-02a/marin/protein-structure/sparsa/runs/sequence-pair-40m-20260911"
result = select_readout(run, device)
rows = [r for r in result["candidates"] if r["kind"] == "ema_average"]
assert len(rows) == 2
model, state = load_model(rows[0]["checkpoint"], device)
assert state["checkpoint_kind"] == "ema_average"
assert len(state["averaged_checkpoints"]) == 2
validation = benchmark(splits=("eval-val",))
verified = []
for row in rows:
    model.relative_max_distance = row["relative_max_distance"]
    actual = evaluate(model, validation, device, pos_weight=state["training_config"].get("pos_weight", 1.0))
    for key in ("r_precision", "long_r_precision"):
        assert abs(actual[key] - row[key]) < 1e-12, (key, actual[key], row[key])
    verified.append({"checkpoint": row["checkpoint"], "relative_max_distance": row["relative_max_distance"], "validation": actual})
assert result["selected"]["validation"]["r_precision"] == max(r["r_precision"] for r in result["candidates"])
result["roundtrip_verification"] = verified
write_json(result, "s3://marin-us-east-02a/marin/protein-structure/sparsa/diagnostics/average-integration-20260911.json")
print("AVERAGE_INTEGRATION " + json.dumps({"selected": result["selected"], "roundtrip_verified": True}), flush=True)
